Final for Publication

TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT PROJECT NARRATIVE
AND PLANS
124-30 E. 75th Street

The Applicant seeks to rezone 124-30 E. 75th Street from a B1-1 Neighborhood Shopping District
to a M1-1 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District to construct a new one-story
convenience store and added customer parking. The existing gas station use with three (3) pump
columns will remain. The convenience store will provide approximately 2,804 square feet of
commercial space and the subject property will provide 6 parking spaces. The height of the
building will be 24.34 feet.

Pursuant to Section 17-13-0303-D, the Applicant seeks the following variation relief: (1) to reduce
rear setback to 10 feet pursuant to Section 17-13-1107-B; and (2) to reduce the minimum lot area
from 20,000 square feet to 13,288.8 square feet pursuant to Section 17-13-1101-T. Moreover,
Applicant seeks all relief as needed, and as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Ordinance for the
attached plans.
